Fixed. Changes:

- `src/bin/bat/assets.rs:21` — `clear_assets` now takes a `cache_dir: &Path` parameter instead of always using `PROJECT_DIRS.cache_dir()`.
- `src/bin/bat/main.rs:69-75` — the `cache --clear` subcommand now passes the `--target` dir to `clear_assets`, falling back to the default cache dir when `--target` is omitted (mirroring how `--build` handles it).

Verified: `cargo test cache` — `cache_clear` and `cache_build` (plus all other cache tests) pass.
